ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution; approximately 65-70% low-intensity (black) pixels concentrated in the central and basal regions, with 30-35% high-intensity (white) pixels localized on the distal margins and the right lobe tip.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Centralized low-intensity (black) core extending from the peduncle attachment to the median notch; high-intensity (white) mottling along the trailing edge of both lobes; a contiguous high-intensity triangular patch on the distal one-third of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 55 degrees; notch depth is roughly 12% of the total visible vertical span of the fluke.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (estimated 3-8 pixel depth) distributed irregularly along the entire trailing edge; distinctive micro-valleys and peaks create a jagged linear boundary.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Asymmetrical convexity; the left lobe displays a steeper, more vertical convex arc towards the tip, while the right lobe displays a more elongated, shallower convex sweep terminating in an acute distal point.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of high-contrast, brownish-white pixel groups at the extreme terminal tip of the left lobe; scattered individual white circular pixel clusters (1-4 pixels in diameter) visible on the dark medial surface of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Presence of a dense, irregular brownish-tan pixel mass on the distal tip of the left lobe, indicating biological encrustation or traumatic scar tissue.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique brownish-orange pigmentation cluster localized solely on the left lobe terminal point, contrasting with the primary black and white fluke color palette.
